description.describe_ch: 計量經濟學是一門結合經濟理論與統計方法等領域的數理學科。其目的在於使用線性與非線性迴歸或其他計量方法來找出合理、可信的經濟模型中的參數。在使用各種計量方法時需先了解模型的假設條件及其估計、檢定方法。若假設條件不符，資料需先作修正。除理論知識外，學生需學習如何使用電腦計量軟體。
description.describe_eh: Econometrics is a course which combines the knowledge of the Economic theories and Statistics. The purpose of it is to find the reasonable and reliable parameters in an economic model by using the proper Econometrics methods. Before applying any econometrics method, students should have the knowledge about the assumptions, estimating methods, inferences of each method. The data should be revised if it does not meet the assumptions. Students should also be able to use at least one kind of Econometrics software.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 我們期待每位學生能夠保持課堂的良好秩序與高度專注。請務必準時參加每堂課，並按照指定的時間準時提交作業，這有助於培養你的時間管理能力與責任感。在課堂中，我們鼓勵積極參與，不僅可以提出問題、分享想法，還能夠加深對課題的理解。同時，請保持良好的課堂秩序，尊重教師和同學，避免影響他人的學習經驗。這些守則有助於營造一個互相尊重、合作學習的環境，讓我們共同受益並取得更好的學習成果。感謝你的配合與努力！
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
We expect every student to maintain a well-organized and highly focused classroom environment. Please make sure to attend each class on time and submit assignments punctually as scheduled. Doing so will help you develop time management skills and a strong sense of responsibility.

In class, we encourage active participation—not only by asking questions and sharing ideas but also by deepening your understanding of the subject. At the same time, please maintain good classroom order, respect both instructors and classmates, and avoid disrupting others' learning experiences.

These guidelines help create a respectful and collaborative learning environment, allowing all of us to benefit and achieve better academic outcomes together. Thank you for your cooperation and effort!
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1.請益時間的說明。您可以在我約定的每週請益時間裡，我可以直接回答您的問題及討論課程內容。如果您在課程學習上需要幫助，但因日程安排有衝突而無法出席我約定的請益時間，請先給我發送電子郵件，另外在安排預約時間。與學生交談是我工作的一大亮點 - 我期待與您交談！
2.請益時間的說明。在請益時間這個時段，我會在我的辦公室歡迎您，您也可以先預約。如果您有任何疑問或問題，請務必、盡快與我會面，以便我們一起妥善解決學習上的問題。也可以運用 lijiunchen@mail.fcu.edu.tw 電子郵件與我聯繫，但我不會在晚上和休假日回覆您。許多問題最好親自處理，所以鼓勵您運用請益時間直接來，與我討論。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Explanation of Office Hours
You are welcome to visit me during my scheduled office hours, where I can directly answer your questions and discuss course content with you. If you need academic assistance but cannot attend my scheduled office hours due to a scheduling conflict, please email me in advance to arrange an alternative appointment. Interacting with students is one of the highlights of my work—I look forward to speaking with you!
During my office hours, I will be available in my office to meet with you, and you may also schedule an appointment in advance. If you have any questions or concerns, please make sure to meet with me as soon as possible so that we can effectively address any learning challenges together. You may also contact me via email at lijiunchen@mail.fcu.edu.tw, but please note that I do not respond to emails in the evenings or on holidays. Many issues are best resolved in person, so I encourage you to take advantage of office hours and discuss them with me directly.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: 在課程中，所有作業、考試皆應遵循嚴格的學術誠信原則，不得從事抄襲或其他不正當的行為。若發現有任何違反誠信原則的情況，將視情節嚴重程度採取相應的措施，包括但不限於相關項目成績不予計算。我們鼓勵同學們通過獨立思考和努力工作來展現他們的學術能力，這將有助於培養扎實的知識基礎和專業技能，從而在學術和未來的職業生涯中受益匪淺。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
In this course, all assignments must adhere to strict academic integrity principles. Plagiarism and any other forms of misconduct are strictly prohibited. Any violation of these principles will be addressed based on the severity of the case, with potential consequences including, but not limited to, the exclusion of the relevant work from grading.
We encourage students to demonstrate their academic abilities through independent thinking and hard work. This approach will help build a solid knowledge foundation and develop professional skills, ultimately benefiting their academic growth and future careers.
